azure-identity.statement: Establish secure identity and access controls using Azure Active Directory, including single sign-on, strong authentication, managed identities (and service principals) for applications, conditional access, and account anomaly monitoring.
azure-identity.excerpt: establish a secure identity and access controls using Azure Active Directory, including the use of single sign-on, strong authentications, managed identities (and service principals) for applications, conditional access, and account anomalies monitoring

azure-privileged.statement: Protect privileged access to Azure tenants and resources, including administrative models, administrative accounts, and privileged access workstations, against deliberate and inadvertent risk.
azure-privileged.excerpt: protect privileged access to your Azure tenant and resources, including a range of controls to protect your administrative model, administrative accounts, and privileged access workstations against deliberate and inadvertent risk.

azure-incident.statement: Enable detection, investigation, and remediation processes with controls that generate high-quality alerts using native threat detection in Azure services.
azure-incident.excerpt: enabling detection, investigation, and remediation processes with controls to generate high-quality alerts with native threat detection in Azure services

azure-segmentation.statement: All Azure virtual networks follow an enterprise segmentation principle aligned to business risks.
azure-segmentation.excerpt: Ensure that all Azure virtual networks follow an enterprise segmentation principle that aligns to the business risks.

source.name: Azure Security Benchmark v2 network security

azure-private-connectivity.statement: Use virtual network peering or Private Link to connect two or more virtual networks in Azure.
azure-private-connectivity.excerpt: To connect two or more virtual networks in Azure together, use virtual network peering or Private Link.

source.name: Azure Security Benchmark v2 network security

azure-ddos.statement: Enable DDoS standard protection on your Azure virtual networks to protect your assets against DDoS attacks.
azure-ddos.excerpt: Protect your assets against DDoS attacks by enabling DDoS standard protection on your Azure virtual networks.

source.name: Azure Security Benchmark v2 network security

azure-backup.statement: Data and configuration backups at the different service tiers are performed, validated, and protected.
azure-backup.excerpt: data and configuration backups at the different service tiers are performed, validated, and protected.

azure-malware.statement: Use endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware services for endpoints in Azure environments.
azure-malware.excerpt: use of endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware service for endpoints in Azure environments.

azure-data.statement: Discover, classify, protect, and monitor sensitive data assets using access control, encryption, and logging in Azure.
azure-data.excerpt: discover, classify, protect, and monitor sensitive data assets using access control, encryption, and logging in Azure.

azure-configuration.statement: Use Azure Security Center Adaptive Network Hardening to recommend network security group configurations that limit ports and source IPs.
azure-configuration.excerpt: Use Azure Security Center Adaptive Network Hardening to recommend network security group configurations that limit ports and source IPs based on external network traffic rules.

source.name: Azure Security Benchmark v2 network security

azure-nsp.statement: Use Network Security Perimeter for PaaS resource isolation.
azure-nsp.excerpt: Use Network Security Perimeter for PaaS resource isolation

source.name: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark v2 network security

nist-account.statement: Create, enable, modify, disable, and remove accounts in accordance with organization-defined policy, procedures, prerequisites, and criteria.
nist-account.excerpt: Create, enable, modify, disable, and remove accounts in accordance with [organization-defined policy, procedures, prerequisites, and criteria]

nist-least-privilege.statement: Apply least privilege, allowing users or processes acting on their behalf only authorized accesses necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.
nist-least-privilege.excerpt: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

nist-incident.statement: Implement an incident handling capability consistent with the incident response plan that includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.
nist-incident.excerpt: Implement an incident handling capability for incidents that is consistent with the incident response plan and includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery

nist-segmentation.statement: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are separated from internal organizational networks.
nist-segmentation.excerpt: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are [unresolved OSCAL parameter: sc-07_odp] separated from internal organizational networks

nist-boundary.statement: Communications at external managed interfaces to the system are controlled.
nist-boundary.excerpt: communications at external managed interfaces to the system are controlled

nist-ddos.statement: Mechanisms protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service attacks.
nist-ddos.excerpt: Mechanisms protecting against or limiting the effects of denial-of-service attacks

nist-backup.statement: Conduct backups of system-level information contained in the system at an organization-defined frequency.
nist-backup.excerpt: Conduct backups of system-level information contained in the system [organization-defined frequency];

nist-malware.statement: Implement malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and eradicate malicious code.
nist-malware.excerpt: Implement [unresolved OSCAL parameter: si-03_odp.01] malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and eradicate malicious code

nist-data-at-rest.statement: Protect the organization-defined confidentiality or integrity property of organization-defined information at rest.
nist-data-at-rest.excerpt: Protect the [unresolved OSCAL parameter: sc-28_odp.01] of the following information at rest: [organization-defined information at rest].

nist-configuration.statement: Establish and document restrictive configuration settings for system components consistent with operational requirements.
nist-configuration.excerpt: Establish and document configuration settings for components employed within the system that reflect the most restrictive mode consistent with operational requirements using [organization-defined common secure configurations]

nist-default-deny.statement: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow it by exception.
nist-default-deny.excerpt: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception [unresolved OSCAL parameter: sc-07.05_odp.01].
